svg.title: US and Hong Kong books, measured apart
svg.desc: Us Book +23.85%, +US$594 on US$2,491 (true_principal). Hk Book −56.04%, −HK$60,209 on HK$107,431 (net_principal). Combined −43.75% in USD (mixed). Each return is total P&L (realized + unrealized) divided by the basis named under it; the bases differ and the currencies are not added. Daily total P&L per book from 2026-06-30 to 2026-11-02. Source: dashboard.json on the data plane.
